WITH cat AS (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE DATE '2026-09-27' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
stock AS (
  SELECT p.category, sum(w.closing_units) units, sum(w.closing_value) val
  FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key
  WHERE w.week_ending_date = DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1),
sales AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(f.quantity) units, sum(f.standard_cost) cost
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cat c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT c.category, sum(r.quantity_returned) units, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) cost
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cat c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT st.category, st.units stock_units, st.val stock_val, sa.units sold_units, COALESCE(re.units,0) ret_units, sa.cost sold_cost, COALESCE(re.cost,0) ret_cost,
 round(st.units/(sa.units/4.0),2) wc_units_gross, round(st.units/((sa.units-COALESCE(re.units,0))/4.0),2) wc_units_net,
 round(st.val/(sa.cost/4.0),2) wc_cost_gross, round(st.val/((sa.cost-COALESCE(re.cost,0))/4.0),2) wc_cost_net

WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5),
cat AS (SELECT sku, category AS cat_name FROM dim_product, per WHERE per.period_end_date BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to),
stock AS (
  SELECT p.category AS cat_name, sum(w.closing_value) s_val
  FROM fact_stock_week w JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=w.product_key, per
  WHERE w.week_ending_date = per.period_end_date GROUP BY 1),
sales AS (
  SELECT c.cat_name, sum(f.standard_cost) sold_cogs
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key JOIN cat c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key, per
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1),
rets AS (
  SELECT c.cat_name, sum(r.standard_cost_returned) ret_cogs
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key JOIN cat c ON c.sku=p.sku JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key, per
  WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN per.period_start_date AND per.period_end_date AND s.store_id<>999 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT per.fiscal_year, per.fiscal_period, st.cat_name AS category,
 round(st.s_val / ((sa.sold_cogs - COALESCE(re.ret_cogs,0)) / per.weeks_in_period), 1) AS weeks_of_cover
FROM stock st JOIN sales sa USING(cat_name) LEFT JOIN rets re USING(cat_name), per
WHERE st.cat_name <> 'ZZ Test' ORDER BY 3
